2608.14011.title: EchoRec: Multi-Item Prediction-Empowered Generative Recommendation via Cycle-Consistent Preference Alignment
2608.14011.paper_summary: Generative recommendation autoregressively generates the semantic IDs of the target item, unifying preference modeling and index retrieval within the shared token space. Recent attempts have introduced Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) into this field, yet they primarily inherit its efficiency merit, leaving its potential as dense supervision unexplored. Unlocking this potential hinges on whether future behaviors qualify as informative supervision. Our analysis reveals that future behaviors carry a semantic echo of the current one far above that of random pairs, which nevertheless decays along horizons under intent transitions, making them informative yet order-dependent signals. Motivated by this, we propose EchoRec, which empowers MTP with cycle-consistent holistic preference alignment across multi-horizon for generative recommendation. It comprises two synergistic modules. Horizon-aware Preference Generation (HPG) sequentially chains lightweight auxiliary branches upon the base recommender, where each branch conditions on its predecessor to respect preference evolution. Verifiable Holistic-Preference Alignment (VHA) further consolidates them into the holistic preference and echoes it back through cycle-consistent projectors to suppress spurious alignment, with theoretical guarantees that exclude the rank-collapse form of spurious alignment under an invertible transport, enabling the holistic preference to be retained in the decoding representation. All auxiliary components serve as disposable scaffolding discarded at inference, introducing negligible online serving overhead. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate the superiority of our EchoRec, together with its naturally acquired multi-item generation ability. Our code and datasets will be available upon acceptance.
2608.14011.paper_summary_zh: 生成推薦自回歸地生成目標項目的語義 ID，統一了偏好建模和索引檢索於共享的標記空間。最近的嘗試將多標記預測 (MTP) 引入這一領域，然而它們主要繼承了其效率優勢，卻未探索其作為密集監督的潛力。釋放這一潛力取決於未來行為是否符合信息性監督。我們的分析顯示，未來行為在語義上對當前行為的回響遠高於隨機對，然而在意圖轉換下，這種回響隨著時間的推移而衰減，使其成為信息性但依賴於順序的信號。受到此啟發，我們提出了 EchoRec，該方法賦予 MTP 在多時間範圍內進行循環一致的整體偏好對齊，以實現生成推薦。它由兩個協同模塊組成。時間範圍感知的偏好生成 (HPG) 在基礎推薦器上順序鏈接輕量級輔助分支，每個分支根據其前驅進行條件設置，以尊重偏好的演變。可驗證的整體偏好對齊 (VHA) 進一步將它們整合為整體偏好，並通過循環一致的投影器將其回響回來，以抑制虛假對齊，並提供理論保證，排除在可逆傳輸下虛假對齊的排名崩潰形式，使整體偏好能夠在解碼表示中保留。所有輔助組件作為一次性支架，在推理時被丟棄，引入的在線服務開銷微不足道。在三個數據集上的廣泛實驗展示了我們的 EchoRec 的優越性，以及其自然獲得的多項目生成能力。我們的代碼和數據集將在接受後提供。
